reviews.title: Impressive. Very Nice.
reviews.comment: Impressive. Very Nice. I paid $37 for this bad boy and its just as good as the high end Logitech mice from what I can tell. Comfortable and easy to setup and use. Functionality is simple, design is elegant. I use a relaxed claw grip with large hands. I like it a lot, especially for the price point. Well done Razer.
reviews.author: Perry Christopher Adelmann

reviews.title: My All Time Favorite
reviews.comment: Great mouse, DeathAdder has always been my favorite. Comfortable in hand, the wired connection is very reliable with no input lag.
reviews.author: Anita

reviews.title: Razer Options are Top Options, but usage of their software is pretty necessary
reviews.comment: I've owned a ton of Death Adders over the years. They're spectacular until the day they're not, but that's after years if usage. Setting share easy to change when needed through the razer applications. If you don't want any additional software on your computer then Razer simply isn't for you.
reviews.author: Andy Steinberg

reviews.title: S Tier mouse for the price,
reviews.comment: Excellent mouse for the price. Feels great to use, the sensor is very responsive and tracks well. The clicks and scrollwheel are excellent. The wire has not really got in a way while using it.
reviews.author: Lisa York

reviews.title: Excelente calidad de mouse
reviews.comment: Llego un poco sucio con señales de mucho uso pero el funcionamiento esta al 100 muy buen mouse comodo y muy buen sensor
reviews.author: DANNY TOVAR
